relations.rationale: Kira's hope about robot balance has no bearing on Ivo's height compared to Noor.
Finishing order in a competition is unrelated to relative age.
Kira finishing ahead of Nell has no connection to Leo helping newer members solder wires.
Kira's finishing position relative to Nell has nothing to do with the color of Noor's robot.
Nell being younger than Leo does not determine her age relative to Kira.
If Nell is younger than Leo, this supports the possibility that Leo is the oldest participant.
Nell's age relative to Leo has no bearing on Leo helping newer members solder.
Nell being older than Kira does not establish whether Leo is the oldest overall.
Nell's age relative to Kira has nothing to do with the visibility of Noor's robot.
Ivo being taller than Nell does not determine his height relative to Noor.
Ivo's height compared to Nell has no bearing on the number of parts in his robot design compared to Kira's.
Leo being the oldest participant could plausibly support him taking on a mentoring role helping newer members, though it's not guaranteed.
Leo helping with soldering has no relation to the color of Noor's robot.
Leo spending part of the afternoon helping others is consistent with and supports the broader gathering activity described.
Noor's robot being bright yellow directly supports it being easy to spot among others.
Noor's robot being easy to spot has no bearing on the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's designs.
Kira's design using fewer parts than Ivo's does not preclude them performing equally well, and could even support that outcome by highlighting efficiency.
